resources.string: One decision can protect your next step.
Processing happens on your device. We do not record or upload browsing history.
Require a protection PIN before sensitive settings can change.
Enable the local blocklist for categorized domains.
Request SafeSearch when the device supports it.
Make changing protection settings an intentional step.
Add a trusted person to help you stay committed.
Keep support tools available when you need them.
Your PIN is encrypted with Android Keystore. It is never displayed by the app.
Use at least four digits and make sure both PINs match.
For stronger protection, open Android settings and enable Always-on VPN and VPN lockdown when available. Lockdown may stop internet traffic when the VPN is disconnected.
A normal app cannot guarantee that it cannot be uninstalled. Stronger control requires Device Owner or Profile Owner and managed-device policies.
What do you want to protect?
Hajiz is a calm space to help protect your next decision, without ads, tracking, or browsing history.
Use Android’s official permission to create a local filtering layer that inspects DNS requests and blocks matching domains.
For stronger protection, enable Always-on VPN and VPN lockdown in system settings when your device supports them.
Strict Mode asks for a protection PIN before sensitive settings can change. The final level depends on Android and the device manufacturer.
You can create a PIN now or from Protection Settings. It is encrypted and never stored as plain text.
Optional. A trusted person can make it easier to protect your choice in difficult moments.
Domains are matched on your device against a local list.
Hajiz does not store URLs, page contents, or images. Only general counts such as blocked attempts are kept.
The first release includes no advertising SDKs or analytics.

Transparency matters: a normal Android app cannot guarantee 100% blocking of all internet content or guarantee that it cannot be uninstalled. Stronger protection depends on official VPN, Always-on VPN, VPN lockdown, and device-management capabilities.
An urge is a wave, and it will pass. Take only the next step.
Breathe slowly: in for four seconds, hold for four, then out for four.
Put your phone down and walk for five minutes.
Change your surroundings now. Go somewhere shared or bright.
You chose a useful next step. Well done.
This is behavioral support, not medical treatment. If you are in danger or need help, contact someone you trust or local emergency services.
